image_description: A close-up shot of two lighters resting on a human hand. The primary subject is a tall, cylindrical lighter with an iridescent purple and blue metallic finish. Behind it sits a standard rectangular disposable lighter in magenta plastic with the brand name 'LOFTON' visible. A human thumb and fingers provide scale and context in the background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Compact handheld device sized to fit comfortably within a closed palm.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lighters are clearly handheld scale, resting naturally on a human hand which confirms the size constraint.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular or cylindrical body with hinged lid or fixed top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The foreground object is cylindrical; the background object is rectangular. Both have distinct tops consistent with lighter designs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flame emerges from small metal tube at top when activated.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lighters are not currently ignited, so no flame is visible. The nozzle structure is present but the action of flame emergence cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flint wheel or piezoelectric button ignition mechanism.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The black cap on the cylindrical lighter implies a push-button/piezo mechanism typical of torch lighters. The rectangular lighter shows the standard metal guard/wheel assembly area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fuel nozzle producing flame from internal reservoir.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The metal tip/nozzle is visible on the cylindrical lighter. The internal reservoir is implied by the opaque casing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Hinged flip-top lid or fixed top with spark wheel.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The cylindrical lighter has a fixed top cap. The rectangular lighter has the characteristic open-top design of a disposable BIC-style lighter.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Metal or plastic casing with brushed chrome or colored enamel finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The foreground lighter shows a highly reflective, iridescent metallic finish. The background lighter shows smooth colored plastic.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Internal butane or lighter fluid reservoir.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The casing is opaque, making the internal fuel reservoir visually untestable.
The objects are clearly portable and identified as ignition devices by their form factor.

artifact_observations.location: Side of the magenta rectangular lighter
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text 'LOFTON' is legible but the font kerning and letter shapes (particularly the 'O's and 'T') appear slightly soft and irregular, typical of AI-generated text rendering, though not catastrophic.

artifact_observations.location: Iridescent surface of the cylindrical lighter
artifact_observations.reasoning: The color gradient shifts from blue to purple very smoothly, almost too perfectly for a physical anodized object, lacking micro-scratches or realistic surface imperfections, appearing slightly 'airbrushed'.

The anatomy of the hand in the background is vague. The finger behind the lighter blends into the background blur without clear joint definition, suggesting slight structural melting or lazy depth-of-field simulation.
